captions: Research: Digital vs. Archaic ESAC Cambrai
The seven-day workshop with 90 undergraduate students from ESAC Cambrai,
focused on the transitions from analogue to digital in relation to communication.
For this, we divided the students into five groups that dealt with the transition from
the archaic to the digital in the areas of belief, propaganda, cryptography, history
Each group also had collective tasks to complete, such as designing an evening
program, preparing a meal, and documenting work processes. These tasks were
also related to the group theme.
Daily dinners themed by the workshop groups
Printing with glow in the dark ink
